blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders for V182: the neutral front and side skirt outline appears more continuous, but the crouch and sit renders still show substantial anterior thigh exposure and skirt panels lifting/folding away from the thighs. The V182 wrap change therefore does not resolve the observed motion silhouette. This is prototype geometry evidence only and does not establish fit.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in the current front, arm-cross, crouch, and sit renders. Their cause is not established by the renders. Visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable and is a separate blocker from the skirt wrap.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
